upstream.description: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company’s context and systems.

classification.analysis: Cloudflare OS is an open-source 'operating system' for AI productivity: an agent chat UI that spins up sandboxed, per-user application instances ('Gadgets') on demand, secured by a capability-based access layer called Gatekeepers that mediates agent access to external services with asynchronous human-in-the-loop approval. Built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, and Dynamic Workers by the Workers team itself, it's meant for companies to fork and rebrand as their own internal AI platform. It's explicitly early access / heavy development (v2 rewrite) but backed by Cloudflare and used internally at the company.

use_cases.title: Stand up a self-hosted AI productivity workspace for a company
